commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

CA_DIR=/etc/ssl/os-comparison-root-ca
CA_NAME="OS Comparison Root CA"
CA_KEY="$CA_DIR/rootCA.key"
CA_CRT="$CA_DIR/rootCA.crt"

echo "== STEP 1: create CA dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p "$CA_DIR"
sudo -n chmod 700 "$CA_DIR"

echo "== STEP 2: generate CA private key =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out "$CA_KEY" 4096
sudo -n chmod 600 "$CA_KEY"

echo "== STEP 3: generate self-signed CA certificate =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key "$CA_KEY" -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -out "$CA_CRT" \
  -subj "/CN=${CA_NAME}/O=OS Comparison Lab"
sudo -n chmod 644 "$CA_CRT"

echo "== STEP 4: verify certificate contents =="
sudo -n openssl x509 -in "$CA_CRT" -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "== STEP 5: install into system trust store =="
sudo -n cp "$CA_CRT" /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-certificates

echo "== STEP 6: verify trust installation =="
sudo -n awk -v RS='' '/OS Comparison Root CA/{print "FOUND_IN_BUNDLE"}' /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt | head -1
ls -l /etc/ssl/certs/ | grep -i os-comparison || true
sudo -n openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$CA_CRT"
